hero.headline: Turn AWS infrastructure into an actionable STACKIT migration plan.
hero.lede: Analyze Terraform estates, map infrastructure to STACKIT services, generate target configurations, and organize the decisions needed to move forward.
capabilities: Every resource of a Terraform estate, its modules and dependencies, read and classified.
Each resource mapped to its STACKIT service with a confidence level and the evidence behind it.
Target configurations written as Terraform and statically validated with OpenTofu.
Current, target and delta architecture diagrams generated from the same graph.
Waves, work packages and data movement ordered by the dependencies of the estate.
Open decisions and inputs collected in a register the architect answers; the next run reads the answers.
Terraform steps, STACKIT API steps and manual actions with owners, ready for architect review.

register.headline: See StackToIT in action on real infrastructure.
register.lede: Each example is one StackToIT run on a public infrastructure-as-code project, published complete: the assessment, the generated STACKIT infrastructure, the architecture diagrams and the migration plan.
